abstract: People may fail to recall and use information they already know when making decisions. We empirically investigate whether such “retrieval failures” distort consumption-smoothing behavior among Zambian farmers, who derive their income from one annual harvest and spend it over the course of the year. We document that individuals underestimate upcoming spending by 50%, creating scope for undersaving. To improve recall, we randomize an intervention that prompts people to think through their future expenses associatively in categories—without providing any external information or guidance. Treated individuals increase “remembered” expenses by 36%–60%; as predicted by the memory literature, effects are concentrated among small, irregular, and stochastic items. Immediate spending drops and, six weeks after the intervention, treated households hold 15% higher savings. They subsequently enter the hungry season—the final months of the year when consumption typically declines sharply—with one additional month of savings, leading to a flatter spending profile over the year. Households use the increased savings to self-finance additional farm investment, resulting in a 9% increase in the next year’s crop revenue. We replicate the intervention’s effect on beliefs among low-income Americans, suggesting that retrieval failures generalize across settings and populations.
title: Retrieval Failures and Consumption Smoothing: A Field Experiment on Seasonal Poverty*

abstract: This paper documents a gap between workers’ formal working time arrangements and their own reports of them, and examines what this gap reveals about informal working time flexibility. Combining administrative and survey data at the individual level, we construct a new and unique data set which shows that nearly 20% of the workforce mistakenly report that they work under day contracts, with no monitoring of hours, while they are actually paid through a standard hours contract. This reveals that many workers with various profiles may be misinformed about the legal environment governing something as fundamental as their working time. We show that these misreporting workers differ from classic workers in terms of working conditions: they perform more unpaid overtime hours but have a higher wage rate per contractual hour, so that their true compensation per hour worked is similar. Working time rules appear not to be fully applied to misreporters, but we find no evidence that employers use the discrepancy to extract rents. Non-compliance seems to operate as an informal working time arrangement facilitating a gradual transition between standard hours contracts and day contracts.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了劳动者正式工作时间安排与其自身报告之间的差距，并考察这一差距所揭示的非正式工作时间灵活性。通过将个人层面的行政数据与调查数据相结合，我们构建了一个新的独特数据集，该数据集显示，近20%的劳动力错误地报告自己在日合同下工作、工时不受监控，而实际上他们是通过标准工时合同获得报酬。这表明，许多具有不同特征的劳动者可能对规范其工作时间这一根本事项的法律环境存在误解。我们表明，这些误报劳动者在工作条件上与典型劳动者不同：他们从事更多无薪加班，但每合同工时的工资率更高，因此其每实际工作小时的真实报酬相近。工作时间规则似乎并未对误报者完全适用，但我们未发现证据表明雇主利用这一差异榨取租金。不遵守规则似乎作为一种非正式工作时间安排发挥作用，促进标准工时合同与日合同之间的渐进过渡。
title: Off the clock? Working time misperceptions and labour market outcomes
title_zh: 下班时间？工作时间认知偏差与劳动力市场结果

abstract: We tackle the issue of producing point, sign, and density forecasts for the monthly real price of carbon in the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS). We show that Bayesian Vector Autoregressive (BVAR) models augmented with factors based on macroeconomic and financial variables yield improvements in point and density forecasting performance, with the largest point-forecast gains emerging at intermediate and longer horizons. In particular, the one-factor BVAR model provides lowest values at six and nine months ahead, while the baseline BVAR performs best at the one-year horizon. By contrast, a large BVAR including all predictors individually does not improve point forecast accuracy, supporting the use of parsimonious model specifications. Simple forecast pooling delivers modest gains from medium horizons onward, but does not mitigate the time variation in relative forecast performance. We also provide a qualitative comparison of model-based forecasts with survey expectations and forecasts released by data providers, which further highlights that relative forecast performance varies over time. Moreover, we consider verified emissions and show that stochastic volatility improves point forecasts, with reductions of about 6.5–7.1% at the one-year horizon. Lastly, we use model-based forecasts to construct market monitoring tools that track demand and price pressure in the EU ETS.
abstract_zh: 本文研究欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）中月度实际碳价格的点预测、符号预测和密度预测问题。我们表明，基于宏观经济和金融变量构建的因子增强贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型在点预测和密度预测性能上均有所改善，其中点预测的最大改进出现在中期和较长预测期限。具体而言，单因子BVAR模型在提前六个月和九个月时给出最低值，而基准BVAR在一年期预测期限表现最佳。相比之下，包含所有单个预测变量的大规模BVAR并未提高点预测精度，这支持使用简约模型设定。简单预测池化在中期及更长预测期限带来适度改进，但并未缓解相对预测表现的时间变化。我们还将基于模型的预测与调查预期及数据提供商发布的预测进行了定性比较，进一步凸显相对预测表现随时间变化。此外，我们考察经核证的排放量，并表明随机波动率改善了点预测，在一年期预测期限上约降低6.5–7.1%。最后，我们使用基于模型的预测构建市场监测工具，以追踪EU ETS中的需求和价格压力。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Forecasting the Price of Carbon with Macroeconomic and Financial variables
title_zh: 基于宏观经济与金融变量预测碳价格

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of the first Trump administration's (2016–2022) US‐China Trade War on the sectoral composition and geographic allocation of Chinese foreign direct investment (FDI) in Mexico. Leveraging a novel dataset of Chinese investment projects (2001–2024) and exploiting product‐level variation in US tariff exposure, we implement a difference‐in‐differences design to identify causal effects. The analysis reveals three key findings. First, Chinese firms responded to increased US tariffs by relocating production to Mexico (i.e., nearshoring), with sectors more exposed to the Trade War (i.e., receiving larger tariff hikes) having significantly higher Chinese FDI inflows. Second, these effects emerge with a lag of approximately four to five years following tariff imposition. Third, place‐based policies significantly influenced the geography of Chinese investment: Mexico's Zona Libre de la Frontera Norte program altered the relative attractiveness for Chinese FDI of the affected regions compared to others. The findings highlight how global trade disputes interact with place‐based policies to shape investment patterns, offering lessons for developing economies seeking to attract nearshoring FDI while balancing employment and regional development objectives.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了第一届特朗普政府时期（2016—2022年）美中贸易战对中国在墨西哥对外直接投资（FDI）的部门构成和地理分布的影响。我们利用一套关于中国投资项目（2001—2024年）的新颖数据集，并借助产品层面美国关税暴露度的差异，采用双重差分设计来识别因果效应。分析揭示了三个关键发现。第一，中国企业通过将生产转移至墨西哥（即近岸外包）来应对美国关税上升，受贸易战影响更大（即面临更大幅度关税上调）的部门获得了显著更高的中国FDI流入。第二，这些效应在关税实施后大约四至五年才滞后显现。第三，基于地方的政策显著影响了中国投资的地理分布：墨西哥的北部边境自由区（Zona Libre de la Frontera Norte）项目改变了受影响地区相对于其他地区对中国FDI的相对吸引力。这些发现凸显了全球贸易争端如何与基于地方的政策相互作用以塑造投资模式，为寻求吸引近岸外包FDI、同时平衡就业与区域发展目标的发展中经济体提供了经验教训。

title: Chinese Investment in Mexico: Trade Wars, Nearshoring and Place‐Based Policies
title_zh: 中国在墨西哥的投资：贸易战、近岸外包与基于地方的政策

abstract: I study the structure and evolution of educational assortative mating in the U.S. using 1962–2025 Current Population Survey data. From observed marital patterns, I recover the full matrix of marital gains across educational groups within the equilibrium matching framework of Choo and Siow (2006) and provide a novel characterization of its complementarity structure using Singular Value Decomposition. This approach allows me to infer the number of relevant sorting dimensions, to describe how different educational attainments are valued along each dimension, and to develop aggregate measures of assortative mating based on local odds ratios. I show that the first dimension explains more than 90% of total sorting in all periods and ranks individuals monotonically by educational attainment, consistent with the presence of human capital complementarities à la Becker. However, higher-order dimensions capture homogamous preferences that help explain the prevalence of same-education couples in the data. I document evidence of a long-run increase in educational assortative mating, with a marked slowdown since the 1990s, although the magnitude of the long-run increase is sensitive to how educational categories are defined, partly due to a coding change in the CPS educational variable in 1992. I also show that high-school dropouts have become increasingly isolated, college and postgraduate groups have converged, and gender asymmetries in returns from sorting have declined.
abstract_zh: 我利用1962—2025年当期人口调查数据，研究美国教育同类婚配的结构与演变。基于观察到的婚姻模式，我在Choo和Siow（2006）的均衡匹配框架内，复原了各教育群体之间婚姻收益的完整矩阵，并利用奇异值分解对其互补性结构给出了一种新的刻画。该方法使我能够推断相关排序维度的数量，描述不同教育程度在各维度上如何被评价，并基于局部优势比构建同类婚配的总体度量。我发现，第一个维度在所有时期都能解释总排序的90%以上，并按教育程度对个体进行单调排序，这与Becker式人力资本互补性的存在相一致。然而，更高阶维度捕捉到了同质婚配偏好，这有助于解释数据中同教育程度配偶的普遍存在。我记录了教育同类婚配长期上升的证据，且自1990年代以来明显放缓，不过长期上升的幅度对教育类别如何界定较为敏感，部分原因是1992年CPS教育变量的编码变化。我还表明，高中辍学者日益被隔离，大学与研究生群体已经趋同，并且排序收益中的性别不对称已经下降。
title: Trends and structure of educational assortative mating
title_zh: 教育同类婚配的趋势与结构

abstract: Dynamic models with discrete choice are widely used in economics, but empirical applications remain challenging because discrete actions generate non-convexities and non-smooth policy rules, and rich state vectors make grid-based dynamic programming computationally costly. This survey reviews recent computational advances for solving and estimating dynamic discrete choice and dynamic discrete–continuous choice models. We organize the survey around three common computational bottlenecks: high-dimensional state spaces, non-smooth decision boundaries, and fixed-point problems in Bellman equations and equilibrium conditions. On the solution side, we discuss scalable benchmarks and neural-network-based methods that approximate policy functions and choice probabilities. On the estimation side, we summarize full-solution and two-step conditional choice-probability approaches, and we emphasize developments that mitigate the nested fixed-point problem, including mathematical programming with equilibrium constraints, Euler-type formulations, continuous-time reformulations, sieve approximation, and machine-learning procedures.
abstract_zh: 具有离散选择的动态模型在经济学中被广泛使用，但实证应用仍然具有挑战性，因为离散行动会产生非凸性和非光滑政策规则，而丰富的状态向量使基于网格的动态规划计算成本高昂。本文综述了近年来在求解和估计动态离散选择模型以及动态离散—连续选择模型方面的计算进展。我们围绕三个常见的计算瓶颈来组织本综述：高维状态空间、非光滑决策边界，以及贝尔曼方程和均衡条件中的不动点问题。在求解方面，我们讨论了可扩展的基准方法以及基于神经网络的方法，这些方法用于近似政策函数和选择概率。在估计方面，我们总结了完全求解方法和两步条件选择概率方法，并强调了缓解嵌套不动点问题的发展，包括带均衡约束的数学规划、欧拉型表述、连续时间重构、筛近似以及机器学习程序。
title: Computational Advances in Dynamic Discrete Choice
title_zh: 动态离散选择的计算进展

abstract: Before DSGE models existed there were large-scale macroeconometric models in the Cowles Commission tradition. In his most recent book Ray Fair provides a clear description of his own model of this kind, a model of the US economy. His exposition provides a compelling defence of this tradition, showing why it is essential that this tradition be sustained. It also contains a hard-hitting critique of DSGE modelling practice. In this short paper I restate Fair’s defence and clarify his criticisms. I show that the issues which he raises go well beyond the details of his own particular model. I use my discussion to articulate the trade-off, which all macroeconomic modellers must face, between analytical coherence and unavoidable detail.
abstract_zh: 在DSGE模型出现之前，存在着考尔斯委员会传统下的大规模宏观计量经济模型。雷·费尔在其最新著作中清晰描述了他自己的此类模型，即一个美国经济模型。他的阐述为这一传统提供了有力的辩护，说明了为何维持这一传统至关重要。书中还包含了对DSGE建模实践的尖锐批评。在这篇短文中，我重述了费尔的辩护并澄清了他的批评。我表明，他所提出的问题远远超出了他自身特定模型的细节。我利用我的讨论来阐明所有宏观经济建模者都必须面对的一种权衡，即分析一致性与不可避免的细节之间的权衡。
title: Sustaining the Cowles-Commission Approach to macroeconomic modelling: analytical coherence, unavoidable detail, and the Ray Fair model of the US economy
title_zh: 维持考尔斯委员会宏观经济建模方法的持续性：分析一致性、不可避免的细节与雷·费尔美国经济模型

abstract: China's trade surplus is widening, its manufactured exports are surging, and the political backlash is intensifying. This column argues that the widening trade surplus reflects not just macroeconomic imbalances but a growth model aiming at industrial and technological dominance, sustained by high saving, capital controls and exchange-rate management. The resulting comparative advantage, engineered through scale, subsidies and learning, is self-reinforcing and hard to challenge. Partners should coalesce around a common agenda combining renminbi appreciation alongside stricter international disciplines on subsidies and market access.
abstract_zh: 中国的贸易顺差正在扩大，其制成品出口激增，政治反弹也在加剧。本专栏认为，贸易顺差的扩大不仅反映了宏观经济失衡，还反映了一种旨在实现产业和技术主导地位的增长模式，这种模式由高储蓄、资本管制和汇率管理支撑。由此产生的比较优势通过规模、补贴和学习得以构建，具有自我强化性且难以挑战。贸易伙伴应围绕一项共同议程联合起来，将人民币升值与对补贴和市场准入实施更严格的国际约束相结合。

title: Global imbalances and the China challenge

abstract: Whether teaching a cognitive skill remains valuable in this era of AI is a crucial question in education and for firms. This column reports on an experiment in which around 1,000 undergraduates in Italy received either (1) causal-reasoning training, (2) access to ChatGPT, (3) both, or (4) neither. While students with ChatGPT scored better in an assignment to write a 180-word recommendation on a real-world problem, only those who had received causal-reasoning training produced unique ideas. The findings highlight the benefits of combining training in first-principles thinking with large language models.
abstract_zh: 在人工智能时代，教授认知技能是否仍有价值，这是教育领域和企业面临的一个关键问题。本专栏报告了一项实验，约1000名意大利本科生被随机分为四组，分别接受：(1)因果推理训练，(2)使用ChatGPT的权限，(3)两者兼有，或(4)两者皆无。尽管拥有ChatGPT的学生在撰写一篇针对现实问题的180词建议书的作业中得分更高，但只有接受过因果推理训练的学生才能提出独特的想法。这些发现凸显了将第一性原理思维训练与大型语言模型相结合的优势。
title: Training novices to think in the age of large language models
title_zh: 训练新手在大语言模型时代进行思考

abstract: We study racial disparities in promotions in a setting in which promotions are formulaic: the US patent office. Using detailed administrative data that allow us to observe who is eligible for promotion when, we document that Black patent examiners experience delays in promotions they are entitled to, slowing their climb to the top of the career ladder by a year and reducing career earnings by 2.9%. Institutional features rule out statistical discrimination with accurate priors. Slow promotions even under Black supervisors argue against taste-based animus. Instead, the patterns fit models of belief-based discrimination.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在晋升流程高度程式化的情境——美国专利局——中存在的种族晋升差异。利用详尽的行政数据，我们得以观察特定时间点符合晋升条件的群体，发现黑人专利审查员在应得晋升中遭遇延迟，导致其职业阶梯顶端晋升速度放缓一年，职业生涯收入减少2.9%。制度特征排除了基于准确先验信息的统计性歧视。即使在黑人主管领导下仍存在晋升缓慢现象，这否定了基于偏好的歧视解释。相反，这些模式符合基于信念的歧视模型。
title: Racial Promotion Gaps

abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model of the attention economy featuring two interlinked markets: a product market, where consumers have limited awareness of firms, and an attention market, where platforms attract attention by investing in free services (e.g., social media, streaming, podcasts) and sell targeted ads using data on consumer preferences. The model provides a tractable framework in which platform investment, ad-driven discovery, product demand, and ad revenue are jointly determined. The effects of data and interoperability policies can reverse over time, platform quality may be inefficiently high or low, and the rise of data-rich digital advertising can coincide with a declining ad revenue-to-GDP ratio.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个注意力经济的动态模型，该模型包含两个相互关联的市场：产品市场（消费者对企业的认知有限）和注意力市场（平台通过投资免费服务（如社交媒体、流媒体、播客）吸引注意力，并利用消费者偏好数据销售定向广告）。该模型提供了一个易于处理的框架，其中平台投资、广告驱动的发现、产品需求和广告收入是共同决定的。数据与互操作性政策的效果可能随时间逆转，平台质量可能处于低效的高或低水平，而数据丰富的数字广告的兴起可能与广告收入占GDP比重的下降同时发生。
title: A Model of the Attention Economy: Data, Platforms, and Discovery
title_zh: 注意力经济模型：数据、平台与发现

abstract: Using administrative data from Scandinavian countries, we provide evidence on international migration responses to wealth taxes and evaluate their aggregate economic implications. We find significant migration responses among the wealthy: a 1pp increase in the top wealth tax rate decreases the stock of wealthy taxpayers by about 2%. A large fraction of the wealthy are business owners, and their businesses are negatively affected by owner out-migration. The aggregate effects are nevertheless modest: the migration responses to a 1pp increase in the top wealth tax rate reduce employment by 0.02%, investments by 0.07%, and value-added by 0.10%.
abstract_zh: 利用斯堪的纳维亚国家的行政数据，我们提供了关于国际移民对财富税反应的证据，并评估了其总体经济影响。我们发现富裕群体存在显著的移民反应：最高财富税率每提高1个百分点，富裕纳税人存量约减少2%。大部分富裕群体为企业主，其企业因所有者外迁而受到负面影响。然而，总体效应较为温和：最高财富税率每提高1个百分点所引发的移民反应，导致就业减少0.02%，投资减少0.07%，增加值减少0.10%。
title: Taxing Top Wealth: Migration Responses and their Aggregate Economic Implications
title_zh: 对顶层财富征税：迁移反应及其总体经济影响
